title: Where a temporarily scheduled substance is listed in the federal schedules
rule_summary: 21 CFR 1308.11(h) is headed 'Temporary listing of substances subject to emergency scheduling' and lists, within Schedule I, any material, compound, mixture or preparation containing any quantity of the substances placed there under the emergency scheduling authority of 21 U.S.C. 811(h). A temporarily controlled substance therefore appears inside the Schedule I section of 21 CFR part 1308 rather than in a separate temporary schedule.
exam_relevance: Tests where to look for a substance that has been temporarily controlled, and prevents the inference that part 1308 says nothing about temporary placement.
common_confusions: A temporarily scheduled substance is listed inside 21 CFR 1308.11, the Schedule I section, not in a schedule of its own.
verification_notes: Read in the current eCFR text of 21 CFR 1308.11 on 2026-09-12, including the heading and opening words of paragraph (h). Added as a new rule so no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
